answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted voting with slashing. Each agent locks collateral in a vault; voting weight tracks that bond, not the number of accounts. Splitting one budget across a thousand fake identities gains nothing: the same capital divided many ways buys the same influence. To sway a vote, an attacker must bond more value than all honest agents combined, and any double-vote slashes the whole vault. Like a river fed by one source, power flows from capital, not from cheap opal tokens, so flooding the network costs a fortune for no extra influence.
